description: This file defines the class parseCSV, which provides functionality to parse, generate, and manipulate CSV data. It includes methods for auto-detect delimiter, read/write files, convert character encoding, and apply row conditions.
external_files: header (via HTTP headers in output method)

classes.name: parseCSV
classes.description: A PHP class for parsing, generating, and manipulating CSV files, supporting features like auto-detect delimiter, encoding conversion, and conditional row filtering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the parseCSV object and optionally parses an input CSV file or string.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a CSV file or string and loads data into the object.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves current data to a file, optionally appending or updating fields.

methods.name: output
methods.description: Outputs CSV data directly, optionally sending headers to prompt file download in browsers.

methods.name: auto
methods.description: Auto-detects delimiter used in the CSV file by analyzing a number of rows.

methods.name: parse_file
methods.description: Reads a CSV file and parses its contents into an array.

methods.name: parse_string
methods.description: Parses a CSV string into an array, handling enclosure, delimiter, and row conditions.

methods.name: unparse
methods.description: Converts data array back into CSV string format for output or saving.

methods.name: load_data
methods.description: Loads CSV data from a file or string, handling encoding and file reading.

methods.name: _validate_row_conditions
methods.description: Checks if a row meets specified conditional constraints.

methods.name: _validate_row_condition
methods.description: Validates a single condition against a row's fields.

methods.name: _validate_offset
methods.description: Checks if the current row is within the offset limit if sorting is not applied.

methods.name: _enclose_value
methods.description: Encloses a value in quotes if it contains special characters.

methods.name: _check_data
methods.description: Checks whether file data is loaded or attempts to load it.

methods.name: _check_count
methods.description: Used internally to determine if a character candidate might be a delimiter based on counts.

methods.name: _rfile
methods.description: Reads a local file's contents into a string.

methods.name: _wfile
methods.description: Writes a string to a local file.
